title: (Pwn2Own) Microsoft Windows Diagnostics Hub Standard Collector Directory Traversal Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Windows Diagnostics Hub Standard Collector. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within DiagnosticsHub.StandardCollector.Service.exe. The issue lies in the failure to properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of SYSTEM.
